description: chrony_exporter metrics for the NTP server. Note: chrony_exporter has no leap-status metric, so that stat from the plan is omitted; 'system time offset' uses chrony_tracking_system_time_seconds and 'RMS offset' uses chrony_tracking_rms_offset_seconds.

panels.description: 48-byte NTP payload + 8 UDP + 20 IPv4 headers = 76 bytes per packet; dropped (rate-limited) requests get no reply. IPv6 packets are 96 bytes so this slightly underestimates.
panels.title: NTP bandwidth (estimated)

panels.description: Includes metrics/log shipping to VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs, not just NTP traffic.
panels.title: Host bandwidth (end0)

targets.expr: max by (chip_name) (node_hwmon_temp_celsius{host="$host"} * on (host, chip) group_left(chip_name) node_hwmon_chip_names{host="$host", chip_name=~".*_thermal|nvme"})

panels.description: cooling device state; >0 means CPU/GPU frequency is being capped
panels.title: Thermal throttling
